Best technical research student paper at TP.CG.2010

The Terry Hewitt Prize for the best technical research student paper has been awarded to "Anisotropic Kuwahara Filtering with Polynomial Weighting Functions" by Jan Eric Kyprianidis, Amir Semmo, Henry Kang and Jürgen Döllner at the 8th Theory and Practice of Computer Graphics 2010 Conference (TP.CG.2010).
